stem:
Meena stands on soft mud in her school playground wearing flat sandals. She then changes into high-heeled shoes and stands on the same mud with the same body weight.
Which statement about the pressure she exerts on the mud is correct?

options.text: The pressure is greater in the high heels, because the same weight acts on a smaller contact area.
The pressure is smaller in the high heels, because the weight is spread over a smaller area.
The pressure stays the same, because her weight does not change.
The pressure is greater in the flat sandals, because a larger area always gives greater pressure.

teacher.key_rationale: Pressure = perpendicular force ÷ contact area. Her weight (force) is unchanged; high heels reduce the contact area, so pressure increases and the heels sink more. Only option A states this correctly.
